## Services

- [Web Development](https://selectionstechnologies.com/services/web-development): Custom, fast, and beautiful websites built with React, Next.js, and modern tech — tailored to your brand.
- [WordPress Development](https://selectionstechnologies.com/services/wordpress-development): Professional WordPress websites with custom themes, Elementor, WooCommerce, and speed optimisation.
- [Shopify Store Development](https://selectionstechnologies.com/services/shopify-development): Launch a stunning, conversion-optimised Shopify store — from setup to payment gateways and apps.
- [E-Commerce Solutions](https://selectionstechnologies.com/services/ecommerce-solutions): Full ecommerce development including product management, payments, logistics, and conversion optimisation.
- [Custom Software Development](https://selectionstechnologies.com/services/custom-software-development): Bespoke software engineered for your exact workflow — scalable, secure, and built to last.
- [CRM Development](https://selectionstechnologies.com/services/crm-development): Custom CRM systems that streamline sales, customer management, and team collaboration in one platform.
- [Mobile App Development](https://selectionstechnologies.com/services/mobile-app-development): Intuitive iOS and Android apps built with React Native — cross-platform, high performance, ready to publish.
- [AI Chatbot Development](https://selectionstechnologies.com/services/ai-chatbot-development): Intelligent AI chatbots powered by ChatGPT / Gemini — automate customer support, lead generation & more.
- [Digital Marketing](https://selectionstechnologies.com/services/digital-marketing): Data-driven digital marketing strategies that grow traffic, generate leads, and increase revenue.
- [Search Engine Optimisation (SEO)](https://selectionstechnologies.com/services/seo): Rank higher on Google with technical SEO, keyword strategy, link building, and content optimisation.
- [Meta & Google Ads](https://selectionstechnologies.com/services/meta-google-ads): ROI-focused paid ad campaigns on Facebook, Instagram, and Google — targeting the right audience at the right cost.
- [Graphic Designing](https://selectionstechnologies.com/services/graphic-design): Stunning visual identities, logos, social media creatives, and marketing materials that make your brand stand out.
- [IT Consulting](https://selectionstechnologies.com/services/it-consulting): Strategic technology consulting to align your IT infrastructure with business goals and drive digital transformation.
- [AI Lead Generation & Growth Marketing](https://selectionstechnologies.com/services/ai-lead-generation): AI-powered lead generation and growth campaigns that find, nurture, and convert high-quality prospects on autopilot.
- [Care Agency Recruitment & Compliance Automation System](https://selectionstechnologies.com/services/care-agency-recruitment-compliance-system): An all-in-one system for care agencies to automate candidate recruitment, onboarding, and CQC compliance tracking.
